name: Satyavati Temple
significance: A unique physical testament to Hari-Hara synthesis where Lord Narasimha is placed directly on top of a Shiva Panamattam.

name: Sri Ramalingeshwara Swamy Shrine
significance: Shaivite shrine where Sri Ramalingeshwara Swamy was installed by Lord Rama.

name: Sri Venkateswara Swamy Shrine
significance: Vaishnavite shrine dedicated to Lord Venkateswara; deity participates in joint Brahmotsavam processions and Rathotsavam.

name: Sri Yoga Narasimha Swamy Shrine
significance: Shrine of Sri Yoga (Pata) Narasimha Swamy, featuring specific Dolotsavam and Ekantotsavam ceremonies.

name: Sri Ugra Narasimha Swamy Shrine
significance: Shrine of Sri Ugra Narasimha Swamy, featuring Teppotsavam, Pushpayagam, and Ekantotsavam rituals.
